sources.excerpt: Son of Pharaoh | Black Arts Toneworks Menu Pedals News Swag Friends & Retailers Contact   Son of Pharaoh Son of Pharaoh The Son stays true to the patriarch of the Pharaoh line. All of what you achieve with the Gold Standard Pharaoh, you will achieve with the Son of Pharaoh,with one exception:You will save pedalboard space. The Son has a footprint of 2.75×5 inches saving space on today’s crowded pedalboards. The Son of Pharaoh has all familiar features of the Gold Standard Pharaoh and same sonic abilities. ALL parts and components are pulled from the same bins as the Gold Standard Pharaoh and Pharaoh Supreme. Sounds the same. Feels the same under your fingers, amps react the same. Same King Pharaoh tone, smaller Son stature. Still handmade. Still handwired. Still the Pharaoh. This pedal operates on a Standard 9VDC power supply. No battery connection. The Son of Pharaoh. All Hail the Pharaoh. OUT OF PRODUCTION © 2026 Black Arts Toneworks. All Rights Reserved.
